lead.title: Premier League title race tightens after a late winner
lead.summary: A stoppage-time goal cut the gap at the top of the Premier League table. The leaders face a tough away trip next.

secondary.title: 'I had so many medals under the bed' - Green on Chelsea success
secondary.summary: When Paul Green left Chelsea after 13 years, he had achieved so much success that the majority of his medals were hidden away in a box under the bed.

secondary.title: Matos on tactics, Klopp's influence, and taking Swans to top of the league
secondary.summary: Swansea boss Vitor Matos spent five years as an elite development coach at Liverpool, but it would be unfair to paint him with a Jurgen Klopp-shaped brush entirely.

secondary.title: Who am I? Plus today's other quizzes
secondary.summary: Test your football knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.

stories.title: Striker signs new contract with Champions League side
stories.summary: The club announced a new long-term deal for its leading striker. The player said he wants to win more trophies.

stories.title: FIFA to amend Article 27 of disciplinary code after Balogun case
stories.summary: FIFA will amend its disciplinary regulations after controversy over its decision to suspend U.S. forward Folarin Balogun’s automatic World Cup ban, the Belgian Football Association (RBFA) said on Thursday after raising the issue with football’s governing body.

stories.title: Anthropic proposes law regulating AI to US lawmakers
stories.summary: Anthropic, the creator of the AI assistant Claude, confirmed on Friday it is circulating a draft bill among US lawmakers aimed at regulating artificial intelligence to address the lack of federal legislation on the risks posed by the new technology.

stories.title: North Korea says tested AI-assisted torpedo system
stories.summary: North Korea has tested a “new-type” precision-guided torpedo system that uses artificial intelligence for target detection and guidance, state media reported Saturday, as the nuclear-armed country steps up weapons testing.

stories.title: Stocks close higher as KSE-100 extends rally
stories.summary: The benchmark index rose for a third straight session. Banks and energy firms led the gains.

stories.title: Floods displace thousands as monsoon rains intensify
stories.summary: Heavy monsoon rain has pushed rivers over their banks, forcing thousands to leave their homes. Relief camps have been set up in several districts.
